chunks: Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Masrur (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: al-Husayn ibn Muhammad ibn 'Amer narrated to us, from his uncle 'Abdullah ibn 'Amer, from Muhammad ibn Ziyad al-Azdi, from Ibrahim ibn Ziyad al-Karkhi, from al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them both). He said:
There are three signs of a child of adultery: poor treatment of people, a longing for adultery, and hatred of us, the Ahl al-Bayt.

key_terms.بغضنا أهل البيت: Hatred of us, the Ahl al-Bayt (the Prophet's household)
key_terms.سوء المحضر: Poor treatment of people, bad social conduct

ai.seo_question: What are the signs of a child of adultery according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) identifies three behavioral indicators associated with illegitimate birth: mistreatment of others, inclination toward sexual immorality, and enmity toward the Prophet's household. This hadith was transmitted in the scholarly circles of Qom and Baghdad through a well-attested chain of narrators. In classical Shia ethical literature, such statements serve as moral exhortations emphasizing the consequences of sexual transgressions on subsequent generations, and underscore the centrality of love for the Ahl al-Bayt as a marker of genuine faith.

en.bilal-muhammad: Ja`far b. Muhammad b. Masrur (ra) narrated to us. He said: Al-Husayn b. Muhammad b. `Amer narrated to us from his uncle `Abdullah b. `Amer from Muhammad b. Ziyad al-Azdi from Ibrahim b. Ziyad al-Karkhi from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as). He said:
There are three signs to a son of adultery: (1) Poor treatment [of people], (2) a longing for adultery, (3) and hatred for us, the Ahl al-Bayt.
